name: @intellectual-frontiers/dossier
description: A sealed, point-in-time file on one subject, compiled from signed evidence through lenses as deterministic AsciiDoc: sources with hashes, lenses that select, project and disclose by class, plates with citations, a manifest of the evidence that a stranger can verify offline, a seal that only a person makes, and a diff by meaning; the same evidence, lenses and parameters give the same bytes, and no reader sees more than their class allows.
